p1: King David grew old, and his son Solomon became king. Solomon was young, with so many people to lead!
One night at Gibeon, the Lord came to Solomon in a dream. The Lord was Jesus. He said, “Ask what I shall give you.”
Solomon said, “I am like a little child. I don’t know how to lead. Please give me an understanding heart, to know good from bad.”
p2: An understanding heart is a heart that knows what is right. Solomon’s wish pleased the Lord. He gave Solomon a wise heart. He gave him riches too, which he had not asked for.
Heavenly Father can give you a wise heart, just like Solomon. Tonight, ask Him to help you know what is right tomorrow.
old: After David, his son Solomon became king. Solomon was young. He wanted to be a good king like his father had been.
One night, Solomon had a dream. Heavenly Father said, “Solomon, ask Me for anything! What do you want?” Solomon could have asked for anything!
Solomon didn’t ask for money. He didn’t ask for power. He didn’t ask to live a long time. Instead, he said, “Please give me wisdom to lead Your people well.”
Heavenly Father was SO pleased! He said, “Because you asked for wisdom and not selfish things, I’ll give you wisdom AND riches AND honor!” Solomon became the wisest king ever!
